metadata.source: Center for Space Research, University of Texas

trend.interpretation: Linear trend in liquid water equivalent mass anomaly; not a direct sea-level trend.

scientific_notes: GRACE measures changes in Earth's gravity field and estimates mass anomalies.
Liquid water equivalent thickness is not direct sea-level height.
The 0.25-degree grid spacing does not represent independent 0.25-degree measurements.
Effective spatial resolution is approximately 300 km.
The water mask is approximate and spatial leakage may affect the results.
Missing months are represented as null in the calendar series.
